Imports

direction, language, script, tag, unicode

Types

Buffer = object
  flags*: BufferFlags        ## Behavior flags.
  clusterLevel*: uint32      ## Cluster merging level code.
  invisible*: Option[GlyphId] ## Invisible glyph override.
  notFoundVs*: Option[uint32] ## Not found variation selector glyph.
  contentType*: Option[ContentType] ## Unicode or glyph content stage.
  direction*: Direction      ## Text direction.
  script*: Option[Script]    ## Text script, if guessed.
  language*: Option[Language] ## Text language, if set.
  successful*: bool          ## False once shaping exhausts limits.
  haveOutput*: bool          ## Staging substitutions through the output buffer.
  haveSeparateOutput*: bool  ## Output lives in dedicated storage.
  havePositions*: bool       ## Positions are allocated.
  idx*: int                  ## Current shaping index.
  len*: int                  ## Logical glyph count.
  outLen*: int               ## Staged output count.
  info*: seq[GlyphInfo]      ## Glyph storage, capacity may exceed len.
  pos*: seq[GlyphPosition]   ## Position storage parallel to info.
  outInfo*: seq[GlyphInfo]
  context*: array[2, array[ContextLength, uint32]] ## Pre and post context codepoints.
  contextLen*: array[2, int] ## Used context lengths.
  allocatedVarBits*: uint8   ## Allocated packed variable bits.
  serial*: uint8             ## Serial for ligature ids.
  scratchFlags*: uint32      ## Shaping scratch state.
  maxLen*: int               ## Maximum glyph capacity.
  maxOps*: int               ## Remaining shaping operation budget.
Shaping buffer holding glyphs, positions, and state. 
BufferFlags = distinct uint32
Buffer behavior flags. 
BufferVar = tuple[width, varIndex, index: uint8]
Bit range descriptor for a packed buffer variable. 
ClusterLevel = enum
  clMonotoneGraphemes,      ## Merge monotone graphemes.
  clMonotoneCharacters,     ## Merge monotone characters.
  clCharacters,             ## Merge characters.
  clGraphemes                ## Merge graphemes.
Cluster merging level. 
ContentType = enum
  contentUnicode,           ## Codepoints before mapping.
  contentGlyphs              ## Glyph ids after mapping.
Buffer content stage. 
GlyphFlags = distinct uint32
Break and safety flags stored in the mask low bits. 
GlyphId = distinct uint32
Glyph identifier wrapping a raw id. 
GlyphInfo = object
  glyphId*: uint32           ## Glyph id or codepoint depending on the pipeline stage.
  mask*: Mask                ## Feature and flag mask.
  cluster*: uint32           ## Source cluster index.
  infoVars*: array[2, uint32] ## Packed property, ligature, syllable, and shaper state.
Per glyph shaping state. 
GlyphPosition = object
  xAdvance*: int32           ## Horizontal advance.
  yAdvance*: int32           ## Vertical advance.
  xOffset*: int32            ## Horizontal offset.
  yOffset*: int32            ## Vertical offset.
  posVar*: uint32            ## Packed attachment chain and type.
Scaled glyph positioning. 
Mask = uint32
Glyph mask holding flags and feature bits. 
SerializeFlags = distinct uint8
Buffer serialization toggles.
